description: This file defines an abstract class 'ImageLoader' that manages image loading with caching, asynchronous processing, and UI updates for Android applications. It handles loading images efficiently into ImageView widgets, supporting features like memory/disk cache, fade-in effect, placeholder images, and background image processing.

classes.name: ImageLoader
classes.description: An abstract class providing asynchronous image loading with caching and fade-in effects for ImageView widgets in Android.

methods.name: loadImage
methods.description: Loads an image into an ImageView, using cache if available, or processing asynchronously if not.

methods.name: setLoadingImage
methods.description: Sets a placeholder image resource displayed while the actual image is loading.

methods.name: addImageCache
methods.description: Adds a disk/memory cache for images, retained across configuration changes.

methods.name: setImageFadeIn
methods.description: Enables or disables fade-in animation when images are loaded.

methods.name: setPauseWork
methods.description: Pauses or resumes background image loading tasks temporarily.

methods.name: decodeSampledBitmapFromDescriptor
methods.description: Decodes and samples down a bitmap from a file descriptor to the requested size.

methods.name: calculateInSampleSize
methods.description: Calculates an optimal sampling size for decoding bitmaps to match desired dimensions.
